title: EvalRequest
description: Single flag evaluation request. SDKs accept a batch of these in `evaluate()` and `evaluate_with_reasoning()`.

flag_key.description: The key of the flag to evaluate. If unknown to the SDK's snapshot, evaluation returns the default-for-type variant and emits an event with `outcome = "flag_not_found"`.

key.description: Unique identifier within this context type. Used as part of percentage-rollout hashing and as the LRU cache key for list-segment membership.

parameters.description: Typed attributes used by rule conditions (`Eq`, `Gt`, `SemverGte`, etc.).

private_parameters.description: Names of parameters that MUST be omitted from emitted FlagEvaluationEvent payloads. Use this for PII or internal identifiers.

ParameterValue.description: Typed parameter value. Strings may carry SemVer; conditions like SemverGte parse them based on the rule type, not the JSON tag.
